global_settings.style: Cinematic legal drama, 35mm film grain, cold institutional lighting, deep wooden shadows
global_settings.default_audio_design: Continuous warm analog room tone with faint vintage optical film hiss.

identity_features.face_and_hair: Sharp jawline, tired yet observant dark eyes, short slicked-back black hair with silver streaks at the temples
Silver hair combed straight back, deep-set calm eyes, deeply lined but dignified face

props.name: 海外帳戶匯款明細
props.appearance: Printed offshore bank transfer record on crisp white paper, dense columns of timestamps and account numbers, one transaction row circled in red ink.

props.name: 無罪判決書
props.appearance: Heavy official court ruling on cream-colored paper, red seal at the bottom, the two characters for acquittal inked in black.

locations.name: 肅穆法庭
locations.description: Tall dark wooden judicial bench, empty public gallery behind a low railing, cold overhead light pooling on the bench surface.

locations.name: 法官辦公室（深夜）
locations.description: Cluttered desk buried in case files, a single green banker's lamp casting a tight pool of light, dark windows reflecting the room.

locations.name: 偏遠分院辦公室
locations.description: Small bare office with half-packed cardboard boxes, a window overlooking empty farmland at dusk.

present_characters.outfit: Formal dark judicial robe with white collar trim
present_characters.facial_state: Calm and composed, lips firmly sealed, eyes fixed on the defendant's seat

present_characters.outfit: Dark grey suit without a tie
present_characters.facial_state: Dignified and still, lips sealed, steady gaze lifted toward the bench

action.description: Judge Xu sits motionless on the bench, staring down at his former mentor in the defendant's seat while a private thought takes hold behind his sealed lips.

dialogue.original_text: 這是我等待已久的時刻。只要判他有罪，我就能證明，我可以為了正義犧牲自己的情感。
dialogue.voice_prompt: Low, restrained internal male voice in his late fifties, cold and faintly eager, close-mic whisper with slight low-pass room filter

audio_control.soundtrack_specification: Intimate internal voiceover under a hushed courtroom room tone, distant air-conditioning hum, continuous warm 35mm film hiss. Judge Xu's lips remain strictly sealed.
audio_control.visual_sound_sync: Closed sealed lips, zero vocalization from the courtroom itself, all speech exists only inside the character's head.

present_characters.outfit: White dress shirt with sleeves rolled up, collar open, no robe
present_characters.facial_state: Lips sealed tight, motionless jaw, eyes narrowing at the document

action.description: Judge Xu leans over the transfer record under the banker's lamp, one fingertip tracing a column of timestamps until it stops on the entry that could not exist.

audio_control.soundtrack_specification: Continuous heavy 35mm optical film projector hiss, warm analog room tone filling the entire frequency spectrum, the faint dry tick of a wall clock, subtle crisp paper friction under steady ambient design.
audio_control.visual_sound_sync: Purely mechanical and environmental acoustic design, closed sealed lips, zero vocalization, zero speech.

present_characters.outfit: White dress shirt with sleeves rolled up, collar open, no robe
present_characters.facial_state: Lips sealed tight, face pale, eyes wet, expression collapsing from ambition into disgust

action.description: Judge Xu stops in front of the dark office window, meeting his own reflection, and his expression breaks as nausea rises in his throat.

dialogue.original_text: 你竟然想為了讓自己的負罪感看起來很偉大，而去毀掉一個人的清譽。
dialogue.voice_prompt: Cold, self-loathing internal male voice, close-mic whisper, low-pass filtered, almost breaking at the end

audio_control.soundtrack_specification: Intimate internal voiceover with a low-pass acoustic filter, a thin rising tinnitus tone, heavy 35mm optical film hiss beneath. The character's mouth stays shut.
audio_control.visual_sound_sync: Closed sealed lips, zero vocalization, the only human sound is the internal voice.

present_characters.outfit: Formal dark judicial robe with white collar trim
present_characters.facial_state: Calm and flat, lips moving as he reads the ruling aloud, eyes never leaving the document

present_characters.outfit: Dark grey suit without a tie
present_characters.facial_state: Lips sealed, eyes steady, a faint easing of the shoulders

action.description: Judge Xu reads the acquittal aloud in a flat, measured voice, never looking up from the ruling, while the gallery erupts into shocked murmurs behind him.

dialogue.original_text: 趙立廷，無罪。本件關鍵匯款紀錄與銀行斷線時間不符，證據不足。
dialogue.voice_prompt: Calm, low-pitched, authoritative male voice in his late fifties, flat courtroom delivery with slight gravel

audio_control.soundtrack_specification: Clean close-mic courtroom dialogue, subtle natural reverb of a high-ceilinged chamber, a ripple of shocked murmurs swelling behind the bench, continuous warm analog room tone.

present_characters.outfit: Loose grey cardigan over a worn shirt, no robe
present_characters.facial_state: Lips sealed tight, eyes glistening, a faint smile breaking through

action.description: Judge Xu sits alone in the bare branch office at dusk, the old ruling open on his knees, his fingertip resting on the circled bank-outage date as he laughs silently with tears at the corners of his eyes.

dialogue.original_text: 好險我那天沒讓那種想當英雄的癮頭給毀了。好險我只是個冷酷的、看見事實的人。
dialogue.voice_prompt: Quiet, weathered internal male voice in his late fifties, half laugh and half tears, close-mic with low-pass room filter

audio_control.soundtrack_specification: Distant cicadas and empty-field wind drifting through an open window, warm analog room tone, continuous 35mm optical film hiss filling the spectrum. No vocalization beyond the internal voice.
audio_control.visual_sound_sync: Closed sealed lips, zero on-screen speech, the laugh is silent and internal.
